**Discpress 1.3.5 says what's inside: its own fork of chdman, built from MAME 0.289.** Since 1.3.0, Discpress has run its own copy of chdman, made faster and with its bugs fixed, while still making the very same CHD files by default. The app's header now reads *chdman 0.289 fork*, and Help → About lists every change.

## Get it

- **[⬇ discpress.html](https://github.com/PowerBeef/discpress/releases/download/v1.3.5/discpress.html)** (about 2.9 MB): the whole app in one file you keep.
- **[🌐 powerbeef.github.io/discpress](https://powerbeef.github.io/discpress/)**: nothing to download, and the way to convert big games on iPhone and iPad.

## Changes

- **The header badge reads *chdman 0.289 fork*** (on computers and tablets).
- **The download and the online version are always the same release.** They're published together: the download goes public only once the online version is updated, and both are checked to be the same file, after each release and every day.

The CHDs are the same as 1.3.0's.
